Here's more from Ray Wert: 

"Literally the bare minimum - attack MAGA Mike Rogers, the guy who would have been running against you had you won the primary.  And that was over a month ago. This is nothing new. This is just who Haley is."

Ray Wert, the Jewish husband of Mallory McMorrow, who finished third in the Michigan Senate Democratic primary behind Abdul El-Sayed and Haley Stevens, goes guns blazing against Stevens after she endorsed Republican Mike Rogers:
